_what: Working-copy path per kernel §6 roster member, for machine-local readiness derivation.
_why: tools/fleet-resume-readiness.py must distinguish a member that has NOT adopted resume prep from one that is merely not checked out on the host doing the asking. Without a path map those two are the same observation, and the second would silently be reported as the first.
_rules: A member absent from `repos` is UNREACHABLE, never assumed compliant and never assumed delinquent.
Every path here was verified to exist on the host named by `machine` at `derived`. This file is machine-scoped evidence, not a fleet-wide claim; another host maintains its own.
Never add a path by guessing from a similar directory name. Absence of evidence is not evidence (kernel K4).
Frozen archives and review clones are deliberately excluded: they are not the live project.

_not_on_this_machine._note: Recorded so the gap is legible rather than merely missing. These read UNREACHABLE here.

_deliberately_unmapped.dng-auto-processor: The only checkout on this host is `C:\code\DngAutoProcessor - Claude`, a frozen archive that is read-only by standing rule. Mapping a frozen archive as the live project would make an unadoptable path look adoptable.
